selection_rationale: Eight universal carrier-creation or exchange claims are strictly killed on one exact full graph: n=14, e=50, rainbow C7, L4(2), A=N[v], four repeated colours, four distinct owned A diagonals, but only K(bc)={bc,cz}. M809R4-04 remains only as a theorem that would first derive a large bounded-overlap catalogue of actual absorbers; none has been constructed. M809R4-10 remains only in the separate actual-carrier-rich regime where total carrier count is at least demand count; the countergraph does not meet that antecedent. Neither survivor may use universal dummies, and neither is evidence for 1/8.
chain_firewall: M809R4-04 must derive concrete absorber certificates from the original graph, prove output edges are actual and unused, and prove a hypergraph matching covering every leftover cut.

M809R4-10 must establish its actual-carrier-rich antecedent in a hard public branch, retain canonical-reserve codegrees, contract maximum Hall deficiency rather than expected matched size, and give deterministic cleanup.
Finite B-side enumeration and conditional Hall allocation are not promotion evidence.
Any deepening must still compose with the exact outer-A gate and all frozen public branches.
